name: Project PRs
description: Every open pull request of the GitHub repos inside an Orca project, grouped by task across repos: review with diffs, merge in order (backend first) or when green, check a task out in every repo, open and merge releases, and follow it all from the status bar. Uses the gh CLI.

settings.title: Merge method
settings.description: How pull requests into anything but the release branch are merged.

settings.title: Release branch
settings.description: Pull requests into this branch (a release from development, say) use the release merge method. Leave empty to use the merge method everywhere.

settings.title: Branch releases are made from
settings.description: The Release tab compares it with the release branch and opens develop → release pull requests.

settings.title: Delete the branch after merging
settings.description: Ticked by default in the merge box. Branches listed below are never deleted.

settings.title: Branches never deleted
settings.description: Space or comma separated. The release branch and each repo's default branch are always kept too.
settings.default: main master development develop staging production release

settings.title: Merge order across repos
settings.description: Repo names, or name endings, in the order a task's pull requests merge: `be` matches shop-be. Repos not listed merge after, A to Z.

settings.title: Base branch for new pull requests
settings.description: Leave empty to use the base most of the project's open feature pull requests use, else each repo's default branch.

settings.title: Agent for Review with agent
settings.description: The id Orca knows the agent by (codex, gemini, opencode, ...). Until it is set, the review buttons ask for it.

settings.title: Folder depth to look for repos
settings.description: How many folders down from a folder project the plugin looks for Git repositories.

settings.title: Refresh every (minutes)
settings.description: How often the open panel and the status bar fetch pull requests again. 0 turns it off.

settings.title: Notify me
settings.description: When your review is requested, a task becomes ready to merge, or one of your pull requests is approved or gets changes requested.
